summary: 一句话：运营管理员可以在渠道设置中从内置目录或自定义表单添加通知渠道，并查看渠道详情
面向角色：负责团队通知配置的运营管理员
核心交付：渠道列表与详情、内置目录添加、自定义渠道表单与校验
关键规则：自定义 Webhook URL 必须以 https:// 开头；重名渠道不可保存
不包含：渠道消息模板编辑与发送记录
background: 运营管理员需要为团队添加并核对通知接收渠道。
目前需要联系工程人员配置，管理员无法自行确认保存结果。
系统现有配置依赖工程维护，尚缺少自助渠道列表和添加表单。

story.as: 负责团队通知配置的运营管理员
story.want: 在渠道设置页面自行添加和查看通知渠道
story.so: 新的通知目标无需等待工程排期即可生效

overview: 管理员可以从内置目录或自定义表单添加通知渠道，并在列表及详情中查看保存结果。

tasks.name: 查看渠道列表与详情
items: 列表展示名称、类型和状态
行操作菜单打开渠道详情抽屉

tasks.name: 从内置目录添加渠道
items: 弹窗内置目录展示 Slack、Email、Webhook
选择后保存并刷新列表

tasks.name: 自定义渠道表单与校验
items: URL 格式与重名校验在字段下方提示

userFlow: 选择内置渠道或填写自定义表单
保存后返回列表并看到新渠道

acs.summary: 渠道列表显示已有渠道的名称、类型和状态
acs.then: 表格显示两行，分别包含名称、类型和“启用”状态
acs.given: 团队已有 Ops Alerts 与 Billing Mail 两个启用渠道，管理员位于 `/settings/channels`

acs.summary: 从行操作菜单打开渠道详情抽屉
acs.then: 右侧抽屉显示 Ops Alerts 的类型、状态和目标，列表仍在抽屉左侧可见
acs.given: 管理员位于渠道列表，Ops Alerts 行可见
acs.when: 管理员点击该行 `MoreHorizontal` 图标并选择“查看详情”

acs.summary: 从内置目录选择 Slack 进入配置步骤
acs.then: Dialog 显示 Slack 的配置步骤，标题仍为“添加渠道”
acs.given: 管理员已打开添加渠道 Dialog 的“内置目录”Tab
acs.when: 管理员选择 Slack 卡片并点击“下一步”

acs.summary: 非 https Webhook URL 在字段下方显示错误
acs.then: URL 字段下方显示“请输入以 https:// 开头的地址”，Dialog 保持打开
acs.given: 管理员位于“自定义”Tab，名称为 Release Bot，URL 为 release-bot.example

acs.summary: 保存有效自定义渠道后列表新增该渠道
acs.then: Dialog 关闭，渠道列表新增 Release Bot 行且状态为“启用”
acs.given: 管理员在“自定义”Tab 填写名称 Release Bot 与 https://hooks.example/release

summary: In one sentence: Operations admins add notification channels from a built-in catalog or a custom form and view channel details in Channel Settings
Primary role: Operations admin who owns team notification setup
Core delivery: channel list and details, catalog add, custom channel form with validation
Key rules: custom Webhook URLs must start with https://; duplicate names cannot be saved
Excludes: message template editing and delivery history
background: Operations admins need to add and inspect their team notification channels.
They currently depend on engineers to configure channels and cannot inspect saved settings themselves.
The current setup lacks a self-service channel list and creation form.

story.as: operations admin who owns team notification setup
story.want: add and inspect notification channels myself in Channel Settings
story.so: new notification targets go live without waiting for engineering

overview: Admins can add a channel from the catalog or a custom form and inspect the saved result in the list and details.

tasks.name: View the channel list and details
items: List shows name, type and status
Row menu opens the channel detail drawer

tasks.name: Add a channel from the catalog
items: Dialog catalog shows Slack, Email and Webhook
Selection is saved and the list refreshes

tasks.name: Custom channel form and validation
items: Enter a name and Webhook URL
URL format and duplicate-name errors appear under the field

userFlow: Pick a catalog channel or fill the custom form
Save, return to the list and see the new channel

acs.summary: Channel list shows name, type and status of existing channels
acs.then: The table shows two rows with name, type and “Active” status
acs.given: The team has active channels Ops Alerts and Billing Mail and the admin is on `/settings/channels`

acs.summary: Open the channel detail drawer from the row menu
acs.then: A right-side drawer shows Ops Alerts type, status and target while the list stays visible to its left
acs.given: The admin is on the channel list and the Ops Alerts row is visible
acs.when: The admin clicks the row `MoreHorizontal` icon and chooses “View details”

acs.summary: Choose Slack in the catalog to reach its setup step
acs.then: The Dialog shows the Slack setup step with the title “Add channel”
acs.given: The admin has the “Catalog” tab of the Add channel Dialog open
acs.when: The admin selects the Slack card and clicks “Next”

acs.summary: A non-https Webhook URL shows an error under the field
acs.then: “Enter an address starting with https://” appears under the URL field and the Dialog stays open
acs.given: The admin is on the “Custom” tab with name Release Bot and URL release-bot.example

acs.summary: Saving a valid custom channel adds it to the list
acs.then: The Dialog closes and the list gains an active Release Bot row
acs.given: The admin filled name Release Bot and https://hooks.example/release on the “Custom” tab
